name: ClinicalIdentifier
label: Clinical identifier
description: A unique proper name or character sequence that identifies this particular clinical examination. (NCIT:C87853)

name: BelongsToPerson
label: Belongs to person
description: Reference to the person whom this clinical information is about. (IAO:0000136)

name: Diagnosis
label: Diagnosis
description: Main clinical diagnosis coded using ICD-10, ORPHA, or SNOMED CT. (NCIT:C15607)

name: AgeAtDiagnosis
label: Age at diagnosis
description: Age of the patient in years at the time of disease diagnosis. (SNOMEDCT:423493009)

name: ClinicalTimepoint
label: Clinical timepoint
description: Relative timepoint or clinical phase of this encounter relative to diagnosis or baseline (e.g. Baseline, Post-treatment, Relapse, Day 0, Month 3). (NCIT:C68568)

name: DiseaseStage
label: Disease stage
description: Broad categorisation of disease progression at the time of data or sample collection (e.g. Stage I-IV, Early/Advanced, Primary/Metastatic). (OBI:0000278)

name: MolecularDiagnosisGene
label: Molecular diagnosis gene
description: Causal gene(s) bearing a confirmed pathogenic or clinically significant variant associated with the patient's diagnosis or response to treatment (e.g. BRCA1, EGFR, KRAS). Do not list all tested panel genes here. (NCIT:C20826)

name: TreatmentCategory
label: Treatment category
description: High-level classification of therapies applied to the patient (e.g. Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy, Immunotherapy, Surgery, Naive/Untreated). (NCIT:C49236)

name: ResponseToTreatment
label: Response to treatment
description: The patients' response to the applied treatment regimen. (SNOMEDCT:182985004)
